text:
kevin.li: Heads-up — had a minor outpatient procedure last week. Provider billed it as out-of-network and patient responsibility is showing $420. I checked the claim and the carrier used an old group number (REDWD-OLD) from our prior vendor, not our current group (REDWOOD-01). The clinic says they used what our staff gave them. Can we get this adjusted to in-network?

sophie.benefits: Ugh, annoying. Short path: provider needs to refile with the correct group number + our plan ID and request in-network pricing adjustment. If provider resubmits with correct group and provider NPI, carrier should reprocess as in-network.

kevin.li: Provider is saying they already filed and got a denial code CO-45 / ICH-49 (group mismatch). They want me to file an appeal with the insurer since the EOB lists the wrong group.

raj.hrops: Either route is fine. Two things: 1) Ask the provider to issue a corrected claim (best). 2) Meanwhile, you can file an employee-initiated appeal/claim review with the insurer to speed things up. Attach proof of active coverage on the service date (screenshot of digital ID + enrollment confirmation).

benefits-bot: Note: typical reprocessing turnaround is 20-60 days depending on carrier. Mark as "billing error: incorrect group ID" to reduce manual review steps. If balance goes to collections, escalate immediately.

kevin.li: Can you share a short appeal message I can send to the carrier along with scanned docs? Clinic is slow to respond.

sophie.benefits: Copy/paste this into the insurer portal or send via their appeals email. Also upload the provider's corrected claim if/when you get it.

```
To: [Insurer Appeals]
Policyholder: Kevin Li (DOB: 1992-11-04)
Member ID: RWD-000987654
Service date: 2026-03-18
Claim ID (from EOB): 99887766
Amount billed: $1,200; patient responsibility shown: $420

Issue: The claim was processed out-of-network due to an incorrect group number on the submitted claim (EOB lists group REDWD-OLD). Our employer group ID is REDWOOD-01 and the provider is contracted with our network for the service rendered. Please reprocess the claim as in-network and update cost-share accordingly.

Attachments: - Screenshot of active digital ID card on service date - Enrollment confirmation PDF - Provider statement indicating billed group number OR corrected claim (if available)

Requested action: Reprocess and apply in-network allowed amount; issue corrected EOB showing patient responsibility adjusted.

Thank you,
Kevin Li
Contact: kevin.li@example.com / (555) 555-9012
```

sophie.benefits: If insurer pushes back saying provider must resubmit, ask the insurer to open a "reconsideration" so they can reach out to the provider, or provide a contact for provider billing so you can loop them in.

kevin.li: Provider replied with a scanned claim form showing REDWD-OLD. They said they can refile but need our HR team to confirm current group ID in writing. Can someone rapidly confirm?

raj.hrops: Confirmed: current employer group = REDWOOD-01; plan administrator = Redwood Inference Benefits; effective since 2024-01-01. I'll send a short coverage verification note to the clinic billing contact with copy to you and benefits.

benefits-bot: Quick checklist: 1) Provider refile with REDWOOD-01 + correct NPI. 2) Employee submit appeal to insurer (use template above). 3) Upload ID/enrollment proof and provider statement. 4) If balance collection notice appears, do NOT ignore; cc benefits inbox. 5) Finance can reimburse temporarily if employee pays a verified balance and corrected EOB later shows refund is due.

taylor.finance: If you end up paying out-of-pocket to avoid collections, save itemized bill + proof of payment. Finance can do a one-time reimbursement after we receive corrected EOB showing adjustment. Send docs to finance-ops@redwood.com. Processing time ~2-4 weeks after docs received.

kevin.li: Thanks everyone. I'll resubmit the insurer appeal now and ask clinic to refile. Posting back when they confirm. Appreciate the quick help :pray:
